# Model Router

Domain + Problem Type → Model. Start here to find the right mental model.

## Domain Table

| Domain | Description |
|---|---|
| Coding/Debugging | Bugs, errors, performance, root cause |
| Architecture | System design, technical decisions, scalability |
| Product | Features, user needs, prioritization, roadmap |
| Business Strategy | Competition, growth, market, organization |
| Personal Decisions | Career, life choices, major commitments |
| Abstract/Analytical | Arguments, ideas, theories, pure reasoning |
| Risk/Safety | What could go wrong, preparation, resilience |
| Innovation | New ideas, breakthroughs, creative solutions |

## Problem Type

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| Diagnose | Find root cause, understand why |
| Decide | Choose between options |
| Understand | Grasp how something works |
| Create | Generate new solutions |
| Evaluate | Judge quality or validity |
| Predict | Forecast outcomes |
| Optimize | Improve performance |

## Domain Maps

### Coding & Debugging
Bug unknown → Scientific Method, 5 Whys Plus | Performance → ToC, Systems Thinking | Postmortem → 5 Whys Plus | Flaky → Scientific Method

### Architecture
Tech choice → Lindy Effect, Reversibility | Build vs buy → Opportunity Cost, First Principles | Scalability → Systems Thinking, Leverage Points | Micro/monolith → Cynefin, Reversibility | API tradeoffs → TRIZ | Rewrite → Second-Order, Opp Cost

### Product
What to build → Jobs to be Done | Prioritization → Opp Cost, ToC | Engagement → Jobs to be Done, 5 Whys | New product → Effectuation, First Principles | Pivot → Regret Min, Reversibility | PMF → Jobs to be Done, Scientific Method | A/B test → Scientific Method, Bayesian

### Business Strategy
Competitive → Red Team, Second-Order | Market entry → Cynefin, Effectuation | Growth → Feedback Loops, Leverage Points | Org dysfunction → Archetypes, Systems Thinking | Resources → ToC, Opp Cost | Startup → Effectuation, Margin of Safety | Pricing → First Principles, Fermi

### Personal & Career
Job offer → Regret Min, Reversibility | Career → Circle of Competence, Regret Min | Life decision → Regret Min, Pre-mortem | Learning → Circle of Competence, Lindy | Negotiation → Steel-manning, Red Team | Startup → Effectuation, Margin of Safety, Pre-mortem | Time → Opp Cost, ToC

### Abstract & Analytical
Evaluate argument → Steel-manning, Bayesian | Challenge assumptions → First Principles, Socratic | Estimate → Fermi, Probabilistic | Update beliefs → Bayesian | Edge cases → Thought Experiment, Inversion | Logical flaws → Inversion, Steel-manning | Causation → Systems Thinking | Philosophy → Thought Experiment, First Principles

### Risk & Safety
What goes wrong → Pre-mortem, Red Team | Security → Red Team, Inversion | Disaster → Pre-mortem, Margin of Safety | Avoid failure → Margin of Safety, Via Negativa | Failure probability → Probabilistic, Bayesian | Resilience → Via Negativa, Margin of Safety

### Innovation
Breakthrough → First Principles, TRIZ | Contradictions → TRIZ | Limited resources → Effectuation, Via Negativa | Simplify → Via Negativa, Occam | Impossible → First Principles, TRIZ | New market → Effectuation, Jobs to be Done

## Key Questions

What domain? | What problem type? | Default model? | One model or combine? | Familiar fit or actual fit?
